promotion_rules: GitHub Actions conclusion is one evidence dimension, never a completion bit.
Distinguish code failure, provider/interpreter divergence, workflow approval, skipped-by-contract, trigger-visibility blind spots, and stale dependency factors.
Only redispatch the minimum failing lane when all orthogonal lanes are green.
When a CI failure exposes a semantic cross-runtime difference, promote the rejection route itself into a RegressionFence.
Feed current green receipts to ProofFrontier so ContextCompiler does not spend epochs re-running solved external checks.
